points.description: Gives one valid use of lasers (e.g. cutting, welding, medical surgery, optical fibre communication, laser printing).
Gives a second, different valid use of lasers from the same kind of list (e.g. cutting/welding, surgery, fibre communication, printing).

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each distinct, reasonable use of lasers, in any wording (e.g. "cutting metal", "eye surgery", "internet cables", "printers"). Two valid uses earn 2; one earns 1; none or wrong earns 0. Cutting and welding may count as two separate uses, and other genuine laser uses (barcode scanners, CD/DVD reading, range finding) are acceptable.
